virtualTable.name: park-api_car_sites
virtualTable.sql: SELECT site.id, NULL AS parking_site_id, source_id, original_uid, name, operator_name, purpose, 'site' as parking_object, official_region_code, public_url, photo_url, address, opening_hours, description, has_lighting, fee_description, has_fee, park_and_ride_type, has_realtime_data, realtime_opening_status, NULL AS realtime_status, site.type :: text, site.capacity, site.realtime_capacity, site.realtime_free_capacity, pr_max_stay.max_stay AS max_stay, CASE WHEN pr_disabled.parking_site_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(pr_disabled.capacity, site.capacity) END AS capacity_disabled, pr_disabled.realtime_capacity AS realtime_capacity_disabled, pr_disabled.realtime_free_capacity AS realtime_free_capacity_disabled, CASE WHEN pr_women.parking_site_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(pr_women.capacity, site.capacity) END AS capacity_women, pr_women.realtime_capacity AS realtime_capacity_women, pr_women.realtime_free_capacity AS realtime_free_capacity_women, CASE WHEN pr_family.parking_site_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(pr_family.capacity, site.capacity) END AS capacity_family, pr_family.realtime_capacity AS realtime_capacity_family, pr_family.realtime_free_capacity AS realtime_free_capacity_family, CASE WHEN pr_charging.parking_site_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(pr_charging.capacity, site.capacity) END AS capacity_charging, pr_charging.realtime_capacity AS realtime_capacity_charging, pr_charging.realtime_free_capacity AS realtime_free_capacity_charging, CASE WHEN pr_carsharing.parking_site_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(pr_carsharing.capacity, site.capacity) END AS capacity_carsharing, pr_carsharing.realtime_capacity AS realtime_capacity_carsharing, pr_carsharing.realtime_free_capacity AS realtime_free_capacity_carsharing, CASE WHEN pr_resident.parking_site_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(pr_resident.capacity, site.capacity) END AS capacity_resident, pr_resident.realtime_capacity AS realtime_capacity_resident, pr_resident.realtime_free_capacity AS realtime_free_capacity_resident, CASE WHEN pr_bus.parking_site_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(pr_bus.capacity, site.capacity) END AS capacity_bus, pr_bus.realtime_capacity AS realtime_capacity_bus, pr_bus.realtime_free_capacity AS realtime_free_capacity_bus, CASE WHEN pr_truck.parking_site_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(pr_truck.capacity, site.capacity) END AS capacity_truck, pr_truck.realtime_capacity AS realtime_capacity_truck, pr_truck.realtime_free_capacity AS realtime_free_capacity_truck, CASE WHEN pr_caravan.parking_site_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(pr_caravan.capacity, site.capacity) END AS capacity_caravan, pr_caravan.realtime_capacity AS realtime_capacity_caravan, pr_caravan.realtime_free_capacity AS realtime_free_capacity_caravan, max_height, is_covered, supervision_type, related_location, ( site.realtime_data_updated_at < now() - interval '30 minutes' ) AS realtime_data_outdated, side, orientation, parking_type, site.created_at, site.modified_at, static_data_updated_at, realtime_data_updated_at, GeometryType(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(geojson), 4326)) AS geojson, geometry FROM parking_site site LEFT JOIN parking_restriction pr_max_stay ON pr_max_stay.parking_site_id = site.id AND pr_max_stay.type IS NULL AND pr_max_stay.max_stay IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN parking_restriction pr_disabled ON pr_disabled.parking_site_id = site.id AND pr_disabled.type = 'DISABLED' LEFT JOIN parking_restriction pr_women ON pr_women.parking_site_id = site.id AND pr_women.type = 'WOMEN' LEFT JOIN parking_restriction pr_family ON pr_family.parking_site_id = site.id AND pr_family.type = 'FAMILY' LEFT JOIN parking_restriction pr_charging ON pr_charging.parking_site_id = site.id AND pr_charging.type = 'CHARGING' LEFT JOIN parking_restriction pr_carsharing ON pr_carsharing.parking_site_id = site.id AND pr_carsharing.type = 'CARSHARING' LEFT JOIN parking_restriction pr_resident ON pr_resident.parking_site_id = site.id AND pr_resident.type = 'RESIDENT' LEFT JOIN parking_restriction pr_bus ON pr_bus.parking_site_id = site.id AND pr_bus.type = 'BUS' LEFT JOIN parking_restriction pr_truck ON pr_truck.parking_site_id = site.id AND pr_truck.type = 'TRUCK' LEFT JOIN parking_restriction pr_caravan ON pr_caravan.parking_site_id = site.id AND pr_caravan.type = 'CARAVAN' WHERE site.purpose = 'CAR' AND site.duplicate_of_parking_site_id IS NULL
